verdict.rationale: vLLM's own documentation lists GGUF among its supported quantization formats, so it directly claims the ability to load and run GGUF-packaged models. The evidence is only a single entry in a feature list, with no dedicated usage docs or hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: dedicated GGUF loading/usage documentation (e.g., how to point vLLM at a .gguf file, tokenizer handling, supported architectures), documented limitations, independent or hands-on corroboration of running GGUF models.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can load and run models packaged in the GGUF format
